candidate_choice: Highest mean common QoE over five mandatory families, subject to frozen physical guardrails and useful-playback gate
mixed_shifted: Reported separately as stress case; not added to mandatory-family average
useful_gate_scope: Candidate eligibility only; never discard scored control or poor-policy outcomes
heuristic_control: guard_only is separately deployable and its result is reported; it is not labelled CMAB or RL
order: One fixed random policy permutation rotated across cases; no performance-based order
protocol_revision: Same candidates, cases, metrics and gates; repeat all24 comparisons after removing uncontrolled externalUTC startup dependency
